prompt:
Research Docker Hub's officially documented pull rate limits for unauthenticated and authenticated free users. Cite Docker's documentation and quote the limits.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on Docker's official documentation and blog posts, here are the current pull rate limits for Docker Hub.

For unauthenticated users (those not logged into a Docker account):
- Limit: 100 image pulls per 6 hours per IPv4 address or IPv6 /64 subnet
- This is a recent change from the previously announced 10 pulls per hour limit

For authenticated Docker Personal users (free tier):
- Limit: 200 image pulls per 6 hours per user
- This represents an increase from the previously announced 100 pulls per hour limit

These limits were confirmed in Docker's April 2025 policy update where they decided to maintain the existing limits rather than implementing stricter hourly limits.

Here are the specific source attributions:

SOURCE: https://docs.docker.com/docker-hub/usage/pulls/ | QUOTE: "Unauthenticated and Docker Personal users are subject to a 6-hour pull rate limit on Docker Hub." | CLAIM: Both unauthenticated and Personal users have 6-hour pull rate limits

SOURCE: https://docs.docker.com/docker-hub/usage/ | QUOTE: "Unauthenticated users | 100 per IPv4 address or IPv6 /64 subnet" | CLAIM: Unauthenticated users have a limit of 100 pulls per 6 hours per IP/subnet

SOURCE: https://docs.docker.com/docker-hub/usage/ | QUOTE: "Personal (authenticated) | 200" | CLAIM: Docker Personal users have a limit of 200 pulls per 6 hours

SOURCE: https://www.docker.com/blog/revisiting-docker-hub-policies-prioritizing-developer-experience/ | QUOTE: "The current limits—100 pulls per 6 hours for unauthenticated users and 200 pulls per 6 hours for Docker Personal users—will remain in place" | CLAIM: Current limits are 100/6h for unauthenticated and 200/6h for Personal users

SOURCE: https://www.docker.com/blog/revisiting-docker-hub-policies-prioritizing-developer-experience/ | QUOTE: "No More Pull Count Limits or Consumption Charges – We're cancelling pull consumption charges entirely." | CLAIM: Docker has abandoned plans for consumption-based pricing for pulls

Note that paid subscribers (Pro, Team, and Business plans) enjoy unlimited pull rates subject to fair use policies.
